name: Marycz
description: An angel trapped and exsanguinated by Markov and his sons to create the first vampires.

timeline.summary: The journal reveals vampires were created by humans: Markov and the demon Shilgengar used an angel's blood, after trapping and draining Marycz.
timeline.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her
